description: Vertex displacement + analytical normal from a heightmap. Three things in one primitive because they share the same 5 texture samples (center + 4 neighbors). Splitting them would either duplicate the samples or require a shared-state primitive convention we don't have yet. Samples heightmap.r at a UV → displaces VERTEX.y → cross-product normal from finite differences. Set height_scale=0 to disable entirely.

uv.doc: UV coordinate (typically from world_uv_from_position on VERTEX)

plane_size.doc: plane edge length for slope normalization
